# VerdantNotes - LLM Context Guide

## What is VerdantNotes?

VerdantNotes is a modern, web-based note-taking and knowledge management application designed to help users organize, create, and manage their digital notes efficiently. The application provides a clean, intuitive interface for capturing ideas, organizing information, and building a personal knowledge base.

**Website**: https://verdantnotes.green-code.studio/
**Organization**: Green Code Studio
**Contact**: contact@green-code.studio
